name: toposhape-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile toposhape_core.py toposhape_job.py test_toposhape_core.py && python -m unittest -v test_toposhape_core > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && pip freeze | grep -iE '^(numpy|pythia8mc)==' | tee /out/versions.txt && sha256sum toposhape_core.py toposhape_job.py test_toposhape_core.py PREREG-TOPO-v0.2.md requirements.txt | tee /out/sha256.txt

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python toposhape_job.py --probe --n-events 300 --out-dir /out/probe > /out/probe.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^TOPO_' /out/probe.txt; tail -n 20 /out/probe.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python toposhape_job.py --n-events 300000 --workers 2 --out-dir /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^TOPO_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 30 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
